decisions.Kwic: 理上也透，事上也透，所謂理事融徹

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yingan Tanhua (應菴曇華禪師語錄). Yingan Tanhua is the exact speaker in this instruction: recalling his own former words to students, he says the clay pellet penetrates both principle and phenomena and calls this their complete interpenetration.

decisions.Kwic: 二六時中卓卓地，六根門頭裸裸地

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yingan Tanhua (應菴曇華禪師語錄). Yingan Tanhua is the exact speaker of the continuous instruction; he describes the genuine student as exposed at the gateways of the six sense faculties throughout day and night.
